description: This Java class configures security settings for a Spring Boot application, specifically allowing access to the root and '/h2-console/**' endpoints, and disabling CSRF and frame options to enable access to the H2 database console.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class extending WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter to customize web security settings.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default security configuration to permit access to the root and H2 console paths, disables CSRF protection, and disables frame options to enable H2 console access.
